Home Crew Schedule Boarding Wiki
Back to top

Station Wiki

What the crew knows about life on board, written down for everyone.

The Greenhouse

Where our food grows, under blue and red lamps.

Read about the greenhouse

The Airlock

The small room between the station and space.

Read about the airlock

Tools & Spare Parts New

Everything we need to fix the station, and where to find it.

Read about tools & spare parts

The Kitchen

Where Ines Lindqvist warms up dinner. Food comes in sealed bags, and water goes in through a small valve. Nobody cooks with a flame on the station: the air would fill with smoke, and smoke has nowhere to go.

Read about the kitchen

The Gym

Two hours a day.

Read about the gym

The Telescope

Kenji Arano looks at far stars with it every night, when the station is on the dark side of the Earth.

Read about the telescope

Sleeping Bags

Tied to the wall, so nobody floats off in the night.

Read about sleeping

Written by the crew, for everyone on board and back on Earth.
